comparison.objective: Fasten an instrument case using separate spring hooks and safety catches; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Choose keepers, engage and tension two loose spring hooks, then set independent catches while protecting case contents, versus captive-screw/collar manipulation and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Closed case must remain fastened hands-off for 20 seconds while cases and instruments stay upright. The record omits exact hook/catch tolerances and force thresholds; candidate instead uses explicit dynamic force, travel, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Although both require secure locking, multi-hook case closure and retention do not test adjustable damping or iterative calibration.
